title: Binance Will Add EigenLayer (EIGEN) on Earn, Buy Crypto, Convert, Margin & Futures
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that  EigenLayer (EIGEN)  will be added to  Binance Simple Earn ,  "Buy Crypto" ,  Binance Convert ,  Binance Margin  and  Binance Auto-Invest  at the respective dates and timings listed below. Earn EIGEN Simple Earn Flexible Products  will be listed on Binance Simple Earn at  2024-10-01 05:00 (UTC)  and will be  available for subscription . From  2024-10-02 10:00 (UTC) , users may purchase EIGEN using any of the payment options supported on  Binance Auto-Invest . Buy & Sell Crypto Users can buy EIGEN with  VISA, MasterCard, Google Pay, Apple Pay,  or buy and sell EIGEN with their  wallet balances  on the “ Buy Crypto ” page, available within one hour of EIGEN being  listed on Binance Spot .  Convert Users will be able to start trading EIGEN against BTC, USDT, and any other tokens on  Binance Convert  at  zero fees  within one hour of EIGEN being  listed on Binance Spot .  Margin Binance Margin will add EIGEN as a new borrowable asset on Cross and Isolated Margin, as well as the  EIGEN/USDT  and  EIGEN/FDUSD  pairs on Cross and Isolated Margin at  2024-10-01 07:00 (UTC). Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates. Futures Binance Futures will launch the  USDⓈ-M EIGEN Perpetual Contract  at  2024-10-01 06:00 (UTC) ,   with up to 75x leverage.  More details on the USDⓈ-M EIGEN Perpetual Contract can be found in the table below:   USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract EIGENUSDT Launch Time  2024-10-01 06:00 (UTC) Underlying Asset EigenLayer (EIGEN) Settlement Asset USDT Tick Size 0.001 Capped Funding Rate +2.00% / -2.00% Funding Fee Settlement Frequency Every Four Hours Maximum Leverage 75x Trading Hours 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Supported Please Note:  The maximum funding rate of the EIGENUSDT Perpetual Contract at the time of launch is +2.00% / -2.00%.  The funding fee settlement frequency is  every four hours . Time Max Funding Rate 2024-10-01 08:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2024-10-01 12:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2024-10-01 16:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2024-10-01 20:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% … … Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the EIGENUSDT Perpetual Contract from time to time, which include the funding fee, tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the EIGENUSDT Perpetual Contract across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the EIGENUSDT Perpetual Contract.  The EIGENUSDT Perpetual Contract is subject to the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement .
